about_the_game: The Revenants is a turn-based survival game with strategy and RPG elements. How long can you survive? The world is destroyed by nuclear war. Fight for survival and limited resources. Manage a group of survivors exploring an infected city.
detailed_description: The Revenants is a turn-based survival game with strategy and RPG elements. How long can you survive? The world is destroyed by nuclear war. Fight for survival and limited resources. Manage a group of survivors exploring an infected city.
name: THE REVENANTS Demo
